name: linear42
description: The Linear-native task lifecycle: Planning, In-Progress, Testing, Human Review, Done. Same gates as task42; the plan lives in Linear (spec and testing-plan documents, sub-issues) and is mirrored into session storage for the gates.

stages.name: Planning
stages.entry_prompt: You are in Planning. Your goal is to turn this task into a plan Yan can approve: a spec and a testing plan as Linear documents, and the sub-issues. Load the linear42-planner skill to run the planning process.

stages.name: In-Progress
stages.entry_prompt: You are in In-Progress. Your goal is to implement the plan one Linear sub-issue at a time, completing each in Linear once it is committed and pushed. Load the linear42-worker skill for each sub-issue. If the plan turns out to be wrong, run `work42 transition "Planning"`.

stages.name: Testing
stages.entry_prompt: You are in Testing. Your goal is to execute the testing plan against the real build and prove the result. Load the linear42-qa skill: it launches the project with `work42 debug start`, records the run, publishes the QA report document and writes the verdict.

stages.name: Human Review
stages.entry_prompt: You are in Human Review. Your goal is to hand the finished work to Yan as a draft pull request that carries QA's screenshots and recordings. Load the linear42-lead skill to open the PR with `Fixes <issue key>`, attach the media and add it to github/prs. This stage is read, build and test only. If the work needs changes, run `work42 transition "Planning"`.

stages.name: Done
stages.entry_prompt: You are in Done. The work is accepted and nothing is left to do.

transitions.description: the plan is approved and you're ready to build
you've implemented everything and want it verified
testing is being skipped for this task and the plan is fully implemented
the plan is wrong and needs rework
the plan or acceptance criteria themselves are wrong
the issue is outside the approved plan
tests failed, the fix is in the code
